title: DynamicNER: A Dynamic, Multilingual, and Fine-Grained Dataset for LLM-based Named Entity Recognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a Named Entity Recognition (NER) dataset and a two-stage extraction/classification method. Although its fine-grained taxonomy includes labels for 'Religious Group' and 'God', the work is a general NLP task and does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a subject.
